headline: Crizac Maintains Full-Year Guidance Despite 37% Revenue Drop in Q2
summary: Crizac reported a 37% decline in revenue for the second quarter of FY27. Despite the drop in top-line revenue, the company maintained its full-year financial guidance.
why: Reaffirming full-year guidance during temporary revenue declines helps preserve earnings expectations.

impacts.name: Crizac Limited
impacts.why: Quarterly revenue fell 37%, but reaffirmed guidance offset immediate top-line weakness.
